newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Express launches Tex/West flight.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Express launches Tex/West flight.

text.p: Burlington Air Express said it has launched a new regional air service within the western U.S. and inaugurated expanded weekday overnight service to Mexico.

The carrier's new "Tex/West Direct" service offers regional direct flights on a pair of DC-8 freighters between Dallas-Fort Worth, Los Angeles, San Francisco and Silicon Valley, and Seattle that bypass Burlington's Toledo hub.
Tex/West feeder services will also serve San Diego, Sacramento in California, Reno and Las Vegas in Nevada, and Austin, Amarillo and San Antonio in Texas, said Burlington.
Beginning March 3, the carrier will fly five flights a week to Guadalajara-Monterrey from Burlington's Toledo hub on a B727-200 freighter.
